name: Fanboy and Chum Chum
description: Fanboy and Chum Chum are fans of all things science fiction and fantasy, and wear wild superhero costumes with their underwear on the outside. Their lives are filled with adventure, from Fanboy's teacher turning into a zombie to an ice monster operating the Frosty Freezy Freeze machine. Their pal Kyle usually tags along on their escapades. Kyle is a real wizard, but Fanboy and Chum Chum are oblivious to his mystical powers, although they live in a world of fantasy.

videos.title: Fanboy
videos.overview: Two kids in superhero costumes purchase their favorite drink and end up creating an ice monster.

videos.title: Dollar Day
videos.overview: The boys go to the Frosty Mart to by Frosty Freezy Freezes, but Chum Chum spends their only dollar on Boog's Chimp Chomp game.

videos.title: Wizboy
videos.overview: The boys think Kyle (the new kid) is a pretend wizard. But, the boys soon learn that their new friend is an actual wizard expelled from a wizard school called Milkweed Academy.

videos.title: Trading Day
videos.overview: Fanboy trades Chum Chum for Yo's Mecha-Tech robot.

videos.title: The Janitor Strikes Back
videos.overview: Yum Yum (Fanboy and Chum Chum's gum friend) comes to school, but the new janitor is on the case.

videos.title: Digital Pet Cemetery
videos.overview: After they accidentally "power down" Yo's digital pet cat Scampers, Fanboy and Chum Chum bury it at the graveyard only to make it come back as a zombie.

videos.title: I, Fanbot
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum have a test coming up and if the entire class passes, they win a bouncy house. Fanboy decides to install his brain into Oz's robot to get smarter, but worse results come to follow.

videos.title: Berry Sick
videos.overview: When a heatwave hits Galaxy Hills, the boys see the Frosty Freezy Freeze machine is on the fritz. They try to nurse Berry, the ice monster who runs the machine back to health but wind up getting "Frosty Freezy Freeze Fever" the moment they lick him.

videos.title: Fangboy
videos.overview: Fanboy suspects he's bitten by a vampire, and the boys go see a neck specialist who IS a vampire.

videos.title: Monster in the Mist
videos.overview: Boog believes he saw a monster in the Frosty Mart, and Fanboy and Chum Chum help him catch it.

videos.title: Chimp Chomp Chumps
videos.overview: Boog will do anything for the boys if he wants to get one of their 3 tickets to see a Chimp Chomp movie.

videos.title: Precious Pig
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum take home and care for the class pet pig, Precious. But Mr. Mufflin catches Fanboy teaching him kung fu and thinks he's hurting him, so he takes Precious back and Fanboy can no longer care for him.

videos.title: Excuse Me
videos.overview: Fanboy, Chum Chum and Kyle get Kyle's Scrivener Elf to write fake excuse notes to get out of various classes.

videos.title: Night Morning
videos.overview: Chum Chum shows Fanboy a time of day called Night-Morning (midnight). Fanboy invites the whole class over to party, but it doesn't seem as fun to them as Fanboy and Chum Chum do.

videos.title: Norse-ing Around
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum meet a Viking named Thorvald, and try to get him back home to Valhala.

videos.title: The Janitor's Apprentice
videos.overview: When Fanboy and Chum Chum are punished for making a mess in the cafeteria, they have to help Janitor Poopatine clean up the school.

videos.title: Fanboy Stinks
videos.overview: Fanboy refuses to bathe for a not bathing record, but his right hand on his super-suit comes to life and threatens to rob the school's charity bake sale.

videos.title: The Hard Sell
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum try to convince Oz to sell something so he doesn't lose his store to his mom, who plans on turning the store into a frozen yogurt shop.

videos.title: Fanboyfriend
videos.overview: Lupe falls in love with Fanboy after he "saves" her from a spider. Problems arise when she won't stop pestering Fanboy once love-struck.

videos.title: Moppy Dearest
videos.overview: Fanboy assembles a mop girlfriend as a date for his school dance. However, when Chum Chum's date, his cousin from West Apetown, arrives at the dance as well, Fanboy falls for her.

videos.title: Prank Master
videos.overview: Prank Day arrives and the boys can't wait to show off their skills. But when Yo can't stop pranking Fanboy, the boys are forced to enlist Boog to help them prank her back.

videos.title: Little Glop of Horrors
videos.overview: The kids are grossed out when the new lunch lady serves only disgusting, red glop and won't let them leave until they finish eating it. So, everyone tries to escape the cafeteria.

videos.title: Total Recall
videos.overview: The boys are desperate to keep a recalled toy of their favorite octopus cartoon character named Agent 08.

videos.title: Refill Madness
videos.overview: Lenny and Boog plot to steal Fanboy and Chum Chum's special cup that gives them unlimited free refills.

videos.title: Marsha, Marsha, Marsha
videos.overview: The boys wind up in the wrong playground and are mistaken for preschoolers. While there, they encounter Marsha, Fanboy's archenemy.

videos.title: Secret Shopper
videos.overview: The boys learn to take care of business when a Secret Shopper comes to the Frosty Mart.

videos.title: Chicken Pox
videos.overview: Kyle transforms into a chicken after getting the chicken pox, so the boys try to get him to turn back to normal by laying an egg.

videos.title: The Frosty Bus
videos.overview: The boys want to buy a Frosty Freezy Freeze from the Frosty Mart's new bus, but Boog won't let them. So, they try to find a way to get their treats without getting bopped.

videos.title: Cold War
videos.overview: The boys are under the weather, and when they wind up fighting each other, they also fight over Kyle's attention when he comes to visit them.

videos.title: Pick a Nose
videos.overview: The boys switch noses for class picture day, but rivaly is just around the corner.

videos.title: Fanboy in the Plastic Bubble
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum buy Boog's plastic bubble from a yard sale, but Boog gets outraged when he descovers it makes the riders bop-proof.

videos.title: Saving Private Chum Chum
videos.overview: After Hank takes away everyone's toys due to no toys allowed in class, he mistakes Chum Chum for one and takes him as well.

videos.title: Norse Code
videos.overview: Thorvald visits Fanboy and Chum Chum and they help him get his battle axe back from the lunch lady.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Fanboy
videos.overview: Fanboy worries that he's shrinking, and moves into Yo's dollhouse.

videos.title: Strings Attached
videos.overview: Fanboy is turned into a puppet and tries to prove himself worthy by doing a good deed, but it doesn't go well.

videos.title: The Tell-Tale Toy
videos.overview: While Chum Chum leaves Fanboy by himself to care for his new Ultra-Ninja, Fanboy accidentally breaks it, and tries not to let Chum Chum know.

videos.title: Fan-bidextrous
videos.overview: Fanboy trains himself to be ambidextrous in order to be a better class clown.

videos.title: Brain Drain
videos.overview: Fanboy gets amnesia, causing Chum Chum to become an open target for Yo.

videos.title: A Bopwork Orange
videos.overview: The boys teach Boog how to stop bopping so he can stay at the Frosty Mart.

videos.title: The Great Bicycle Mystery
videos.overview: When Lenny's bike gets destroyed outside the Frosty Mart, Fanboy and Chum Chum try to determine who did it.

videos.title: Sigmund the Sorcerer
videos.overview: Kyle is not pleased when his old rival, Sigmund the Sorcerer, shows up in Galaxy Hills. And when Sigmund comes over to his place for dinner, Kyle tries to pass Fanboy and Chum Chum off as his elf assistants.

videos.title: Fanboy A'Hoy!
videos.overview: While playing pirates, the boys accidentally bury the map with the treasure, so they get the whole class together to help find it.

videos.title: Freeze Tag
videos.overview: Man-Arctica takes a game of freeze tag up to a new level by freezing everybody! Fanboy and Chum Chum do their best not to get frozen.

videos.title: Jingle Fever
videos.overview: Lenny tries to ruin Fanboy and Chum Chum's chances of winning a million Frosty Bucks by stopping them from writing a jingle.

videos.title: Lord of the Rings
videos.overview: Kyle tries to find out how Fanboy can connect two rings together.

videos.title: The Incredible Chulk
videos.overview: Chum Chum grows into a Chulk, and Fanboy has fun. But when Chum Chum shrinks to normal size due to Boog scaring him, Fanboy tries to make him grow again.

videos.title: Eyes on the Prize
videos.overview: The boys have no luck while searching for a cereal box toy that's in limited condition, so they seek help from Oz.

videos.title: Battle of the Stands
videos.overview: The boys start a lemonade stand, but Lupe and Yo start a competing one across the street.

videos.title: The Book Report of the Dead
videos.overview: Fanboy swipes Kyle's spellbook to finish his book report, but ends up turning Mr. Mufflin into a zombie.

videos.title: Separation Anxiety
videos.overview: The boys' desks are separated for singing out loud during "Quiet Time", so they try to get reunited.

videos.title: Fan vs. Wild
videos.overview: Fanboy, Chum Chum and Kyle go camping on the Frosty Mart roof, but Kyle accidentally drops the rope to get down, forcing the boys to try and survive in the roof's bitter, cold, frosty weather!

videos.title: Man-Arctica the Ride
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum are eager to ride a new roller coaster, but Fanboy's excitement later turns into fear.

videos.title: Stan Arctica
videos.overview: Man-Arctica poses as a storeworker named Stan at Oz's when Fanboy and Chum Chum believe that he disappeared forever.

videos.title: I'm Man-Arctica!
videos.overview: Man-Arctica tries to prove who he is when Fanboy and Chum Chum refuse to believe him.

videos.title: No Toy Story
videos.overview: The boys throw out everything they believe to be baby toys, leaving them with an empty Fanlair.

videos.title: GameBoy
videos.overview: After the boys accidentally release the monkey from Boog's favorite video game, Chum Chum sneaks into the machine and pretends to be Chimp Chomp so that Boog doesn't find out.

videos.title: Crib Notes
videos.overview: Kyle's scheme to cheat his way back into Milkweed backfires when his spell for crib notes turns him into a baby.

videos.title: Schoolhouse Lock
videos.overview: The boys get locked in the school right before summer vacation.

videos.title: Back From The Future
videos.overview: Lenny goes back in time to stop the boys from having their first Frosty Freezy Freeze.

videos.title: Tooth or Scare
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum accidentally cause Kyle to lose a tooth, which means the Wizard Tooth Fairy is coming. But unlike the normal Tooth Fairy, when the Wizard Tooth Fairy comes, he takes all your teeth.

videos.title: The Big Bopper
videos.overview: Boog meets a bully much bigger and more aggressive than him.

videos.title: Present Not Accounted For
videos.overview: Fanboy forgets Chum Chum's birthday, and desperately scrambles to find a gift for him.

videos.title: The Sword in the Throne
videos.overview: When Fanboy learns that he is the king of the janitors, Janitor Poopatine is forced to tutor him by the Custodial Council.

videos.title: Brain Freeze
videos.overview: After losing their memories from a wicked brain freeze, Fanboy and Chum Chum must retrace their steps to locate their missing underwear.

videos.title: Slime Day
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum can't figure out how to get slimed on Slime Day, because they don't know the secret phrase. So they travel to the Nickelodeon studio to get the secret phrase from the president of the company.

videos.title: Boog Zapper
videos.overview: Fed up with Boog's bullying, Fanboy builds up an electric charge so he can shock Boog.

videos.title: Risky Brizness
videos.overview: When Oz's cousin, Brizwald, comes to town, Oz is certain he is after his most valuable Man-Arctica comic book.

videos.title: Kids In The Hall
videos.overview: Hall monitors Fanboy and Chum Chum complicate Kyle's attempt to get back into Milkweed Academy.

videos.title: Frosty Mart Dream Vacation
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum win a dream vacation and believe that means they can take it at the Frosty Mart.

videos.title: Field Trip of Horrors
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum try to derail a field trip to the horrible Glop Mines, where they've heard that a kid-eating glop monster lives.

videos.title: There Will Be Shrieks
videos.overview: When Fanboy and Chum Chum lose their taste sense to a Halloween spirit, Mr. Trick, they try to bring him 1,000 screams in order to get it back.

videos.title: Igloo of Irritation
videos.overview: When the boys crash land on Planet Hasselhoth, their friendly visit with Man-Arctica results in the trio's capture by Man-Arctica's nemesis, Global Warmer.

videos.title: HypnotOZed
videos.overview: When Oz's new, vintage Boom Bot toy hypnotizes him into selling items whenever the doorbell to his shop rings, he ends up selling all of his collectors' items.

videos.title: Robo-mance
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum play cupids when Dollar-nator falls in love with Oz's new robot librarian, Julie Android.

videos.title: Rattleskunkupine!
videos.overview: The boys find a new pet that's a cross between a rattlesnake, a skunk, and a porcupine. This animal is called the rattleskunkupine, but Fanboy and Chum Chum name it Scooter. They have to hide it from Oz when they learn that it's terrorizing the city.

videos.title: Bubble Trouble
videos.overview: Boog is ecstatic to meet the Chimp Chomp champion. However, the boys have to get Boog across the street when he has an allergy to their Man-Arctic Seal uniforms and is stuck in his childhood bubble.

videos.title: Lucky Chums
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum find a Leprechaun in a box of cereal, but he refuses to give them the mystery cereal shape the cereal box promised.

videos.title: The Last Strawberry Fun Finger
videos.overview: The boys find a third Strawberry Fun Finger in their usual two-pack and desperately try to decide who gets to eat it.

videos.title: Power Out
videos.overview: The boys cause a town-wide blackout when they settle in to watch a movie called Robot Pirate Ninja President from the future.

videos.title: Dental Illness
videos.overview: When Fanboy gets a toothache, he must overcome his fear of the dentist to seek treatment. Worst of all, the dentist is a vampire with a scary-sounding machine called the Extractor in his office.

videos.title: Champ of Chomp
videos.overview: The boys endeavor to help Boog beat the all-time record in Chimp Chomp. However they accidentally unplug the machine and delete Boog's score when he finally beats the record.

videos.title: Lice Lice Baby
videos.overview: The boys develop a crush on Nurse Lady Pam on Lice Inspection Day, and soon both fight over her affection.

videos.title: Get You Next Time
videos.overview: After Retchy Lintpockets spots Fanboy a piece of taffy on credit, Fanboy promises to get him next time. But instead, Retchy promises to get Fanboy next time, in this Raimi-esque tale of suspense!

videos.title: A Very Brrr-y Icemas
videos.overview: After Fanboy winds up on Man-Arctica's Naughty List, the boys infiltrate the Igloo of Isolation to try to get him back onto the Good List in time for Icemas.

videos.title: Funny Face
videos.overview: After Fanboy creates the perfect goofy face, he is determined to use it to make the class photo hilarious.

videos.title: Put That Cookie Down!
videos.overview: Lenny bakes Chocolatonium chip cookies for Agent Johnson's birthday and orders Dollar-nator to keep them away from Fanboy and Chum Chum at all costs.

videos.title: Two Tickets to Paladise
videos.overview: When best pals Fanboy and Chum Chum notice a frightening rift in their friendship, Oz teaches them how to return to paladise.

videos.title: The Winners
videos.overview: After Fanboy and Chum Chum discover they have the Frosty Freezy Freeze Sweepstakes winning cup, everyone in Galaxy Hills conspires to take it from them.

videos.title: Hex Games
videos.overview: Kyle is angered when Sigmund releases a new video game, but when he learns the winner gets to go to Milkweed, Fanboy and Chum Chum help him win it.

videos.title: Speed Eraser
videos.overview: When Kyle loses his job as Official Chalkboard Eraser to Fanboy, Kyle gives him a magical eraser that can erase whole objects, hoping it will get Fanboy in trouble.

videos.title: Heroes vs. Villains
videos.overview: After reading a captivating comic book, the boys don't agree on whether heroes are better than villains, or if villains are better than heroes. They continue their debate as Super Chum and Fannihilator.

videos.title: Face-Eating Aliens From Planet X
videos.overview: The boys dress up like girls to infiltrate Yo's slumber party to prove that girls are face-eating aliens from Planet X.

videos.title: The Cold Rush
videos.overview: Faniel and Chumtholemew are two 1800s wild west prospectors on the hunt for the fabled Frosty Freezy Freeze.

videos.title: Camp-Arctica
videos.overview: The boys win an opportunity to hang out with Man-Arctica at his insufferably cold summer camp, only to discover an easy escape at Global Warmer's summer camp.

videos.title: Buddy Up
videos.overview: Fanboy, Chum Chum and Kyle get lost in the desert after partnering up for a field trip to the Dinosaur Museum, and later encounter a dinosaur in real life.

videos.title: Normal Day
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum's plans to have a totally normal day are ruined when all the weird things and characters they've been faced with on their many adventures return to town, including Thorvald.

videos.title: Microphonies
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum's new Ultra Deluxe Mega Mic toy allows them to make their own crazy sound effects in addition to auto-tuning their voices. Problems arise when Fanboy and Chum Chum abuse the Mega Mic and make Mr. Mufflin think that school's out. Things get even worse when it starts to make sounds on its own.

videos.title: Freezy Freaks
videos.overview: When Boog is forced to wear the costume of the Frosty Mart mascot Freezy, the boys are convinced he is the real Freezy.

videos.title: Super Chums
videos.overview: In this superhero cartoon parody, Super Chum works with Fannihilator to stop Copy Kitten from taking Fannihilator's place as Super Chum's best nemesis.

videos.title: Attack of the Clones
videos.overview: The boys create clones of themselves so they can go on a field trip to the thermometer factory. But the inattentive clones create more clones, and the town is quickly overrun by highly unstable, zombie-like Cloneboys and Chum Clones.

videos.title: Secret Club
videos.overview: Fanboy and Chum Chum learn about a secret club in Galaxy Hills and do whatever they can to locate it.
